opis: A cosy winter FEAST in the kitchen from the reference picture, snow outside the window: the SQUIRREL, the FOX and the ROE DEER sit round the wooden table, laughing; in the middle ONE big apple cake on a plate and a bowl full of many red cherries; one big orange pumpkin on the shelf; a little HEDGEHOG and a mother DUCK with her fluffy yellow ducklings have come to visit and stand by the table. Warm light, steam from cups of tea.
